content:
samira: Hey team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/2987 is blocked by a flaky unit test in CI (TestSuite > chrome-render > snapshot mismatch). CI shows a diff but I can't repro locally. Can someone take a look or approve so we can at least rerun?

ci-bot: CI job failed: unit-tests-pr (job 5467). Log: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/5467 :x:

alexander: I can take a look in ~30m. Which test name exactly?

samira: It's chrome-render/snapshots/RenderHeader.snap — failure looks like small whitespace change in computed classnames. No API changes in this PR, it's just a refactor of hydration timing.

maria: If it's only whitespace in snapshot, we should avoid blindly updating snapshots. Could be flakiness introduced by test order. Can we rerun once first? :thinking_face:

ken: Agreed — rerun first. If it reappears consistently, we'll either update snapshot or add a more stable matcher. Also worth checking if this PR changed test setup timing (jest fake timers?).

qa_tester: I can trigger a rerun in CI now. Ping me again if it flakes after 2 reruns and I'll isolate the job.

samira: please do — thanks. Also need 1 approval from eng for merge once CI is green. @alexander if rerun passes can you approve?

alexander: Yep. I'll review before approving. If it's a flake and rerun fixes it, I'll add an approval.

devops-bot: Suggestion: run isolated job to avoid hitting concurrency cache shims. Command: `gh actions run workflow --repo redwood-inference/service --workflow unit-tests.yml --ref refs/pull/2987`

ci-bot: Rerun triggered by qa_tester — job 5470 queued.

samira: Quick question — if rerun fails again, is it acceptable to mark the test flaky in jest.config and open a follow-up ticket to fix? We have a launch window at EOD.

maria: Do not merge if failing CI. Marking flaky temporarily is ok but must include a JIRA with owner and timeline. We don't want regressions hidden.

ken: If the failure is nondeterministic and blocking launch, mark flaky and create a follow-up with steps to reproduce + owner. Prefer small change to skip on CI only (skipOnCICircumstances) rather than removing assertion.

ci-bot: Job 5470 completed — unit-tests-pr: flaky failure reproduced (same snapshot diff). :warning:

alexander: Since rerun reproduced, I'll dig in now. Might be a dependency on browser viewport/locale in our snapshot harness.

samira: I can try running the failing test in Docker image used by CI and post logs.

qa_tester: I ran an isolated job per devops-bot command — job 5478 passed. So this looks intermittent across runners.

maria: Mixed results across runners = flake. Okay to proceed with temporary skip in CI for that test, but we need a follow-up ticket assigned to @alexander to root cause. Samira — can you open the ticket and tag Alex?

samira: Created ticket INF-6573 (link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-6573) — assigned Alex, priority P2.

alexander: Thanks. I'll investigate tomorrow morning. For now I'm going to approve the PR once CI shows a green on main job 5478.

samira: Thanks all — I'll wait for job 5478 so we can merge before EOD. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Job 5478 status: success. All checks green. :white_check_mark:

alexander: Approved.

samira: Merged — thanks everyone. I'll follow up on INF-6573 with repro steps and logs.

maria: Nice — good coordination. If INF-6573 needs infra help, ping eng-infra.

ken: :rocket:

devops-bot: Reminder: when marking tests flaky, add `ci:flake` label and include targeted runner images to narrow repro.
